text: So once he did this, and the [[Najashi|النجاشي]] went back to [[Habashah|حبشة]],
[[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] was relieved, of course, but he still had some fear in his heart,
because of course, this was all done through the messenger. [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] and the [[Najashi|النجاشي]], they didn't meet face-to-face for this meeting.
So he was still kind of afraid. He was like, "Okay, things are calmed down for now,
but maybe the [[Najashi|النجاشي]], he's planning something.
Maybe he's just keeping the status quo for now, but eventually he's going to come and try to get me out of rule, and he's going to try to replace me or something."
So this paranoia and this fear started developing in [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]].
So he wanted to do something to show the [[Najashi|النجاشي]] what high esteem he holds him in,
what high respect and veneration he has for the [[Najashi|النجاشي]]. He wanted to do something to symbolize his loyalty towards the [[Najashi|النجاشي]].
So he orders for a huge church to be built in [[Yemen|اليمن]].
[[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] orders for a big church to be built in [[Yemen|اليمن]], very big and very intricate, and, you know, very dazzling, this church.
So he built this big church in honor of the [[Najashi|النجاشي]],
and he sent a message to the [[Najashi|النجاشي]]. He said, "Ya [[Najashi|نجاشي]], I built this huge, beautiful church in [[Yemen|اليمن]] for you,
in your honor, and I am going to order all of the Arabs, from the different tribes of the Arabs,
to come and make pilgrimage to this church.
I'm going to order all of them to make pilgrimage to this church. The Arabs should come and make pilgrimage to this church, and this is an honor to you, ya [[Najashi|نجاشي]]."
So he wanted to do this just to show his respect for the [[Najashi|النجاشي]], so the [[Najashi|النجاشي]] would not do anything to take away his rule.
So he built this church, and he actually tried to order the different tribes of the Arabs to come and make pilgrimage to this church.
So he sent the orders to the different tribes of the Arabs.
And one of the groups of the Arabs that this order reached,
they were called [[Ahl al-Nasi'|أهل النسيء]], [[Ahl al-Nasi'|أهل النسيء]].
And the word [[nasi'|نسيء]] in Arabic, it means delay.
It means delay. And why were they called [[Ahl al-Nasi'|أهل النسيء]]?
They were a group of Arabs, these people,
who had the utmost respect for the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], for the House of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]].
They venerated the House of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], they respected the House of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]],
even though they were not [[Muwahhidin|مُوَحِّدِين]], they were not people of [[tawhid|توحيد]].
And you know that the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] was built by [[Ibrahim|إبراهيم]] [[alayhis-salam|عليه السلام]],
and then after many years, [[shirk|شرك]] came back into the Arabian Peninsula, as we spoke about before.
So they were worshipping idols, and they were worshipping other things as well, but they still kept their respect for the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]].
They still respected the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], and they still used to make [[tawaf|طواف]] around the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], they used to make [[sa'i|سعي]], they used to do all of these things.
